IGUI_TienSkillMastery_Intro: Pick up to %1 masteries once every skill in them is at level 10.
IGUI_TienSkillMastery_Info: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> Mastery <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:small> <LEFT> A mastery is a group of skills with effects of its own. Once every skill in it is at level 10 it can be picked; a character holds at most three, and picks are permanent. <LINE> <LINE> A picked mastery earns from experience in its skills, levels 1 to 10, each giving a tenth of its effects. Past mastery 10 it keeps counting as prestige. Only experience counts, never reading. If one of its skills drops below 10 it pauses until the skill is back. Mastery belongs to the character and is gone when it dies.
